fit_method.uncertainty: parametric Monte Carlo noise, 100 draws per fit (statistical only; tiny). Systematic spread: see centre_slice_repeatability and mode0_repeatability_pm2p8
fit_method.alias_note: (s,h) == (s+-180, h+-90); tool reports smaller |h|; rep_ambiguous = both |h| >= 30

frequency_check.tool: tools/frequency_check.py A B (re-run through its own image(); same call as the CLI)
frequency_check.resolution_note: phase_cross_correlation upsample_factor 20 -> 0.05 px resolution = +-16 Hz; shifts at factor 10/20/100 agree to 0.01 px
frequency_check.sign_note: sign of df is not calibrated (as in the tool)

column_centroid_px.note: centroid of the readout projection above 20% of its peak; A-B should be ~0 if df~0 (A displaced 2x B per Hz). In pixels of the same FOV.

cross_version_registration.note: ex vivo single slice: v1.83 vs v1.912
ex vivo single slice: v1.83 vs v1.912 (4-volume scans)
ex vivo centre slice of Q/R (matched 3-slice, v1.83 vs v1.912)
in vivo centre slice: v1.83 vs v1.912 (the requested comparison)
in vivo: v1.83 vs v1.912 single slice
in vivo: v1.912 vs v1.912 (same-sequence control)
in vivo: v1.83 vs v1.83 (same-sequence control)

frequency_check.cross_version_note: Both scans of a pair use 40 kHz, so a readout shift d corresponds to df = d*312.5 Hz only if nothing else moved. In vivo, motion contributes too: the phase-encode shift of the same pair is the motion control, and the same-sequence in-vivo pairs (iB-iC, iA-iD) show the shift between unrelated acquisitions.

best_P_minimax_over_0_1000_ticks.note: interpolated through only three phcal values (-530, 0, +530) per slice, so +-50 ticks

ex_vivo_mode0.label: ex vivo v1.83 mode 0 (D, QQ, QQQ, Q, MM, Q1; b10)

in_vivo_mode0.label: in vivo v1.83 mode 0 (iA, iD, iE, iF; b10, fit rms <= 25 deg)

in_vivo_ghost_excess.note: surface-coil images: mask = threshold of the head+coil profile; ghost fraction only, no banding metric

metric_definitions.band_cv: std of 3rd-order-detrended row means over a uniform-PBS ROI / mean; band_excess = sqrt(band_cv^2 - band_cv_centre^2) of the same scan's centre slice
metric_definitions.ghost_frac: sum |I|^2 outside (object mask dilated 3 px) / total; ghost_excess = off-centre minus centre of the same scan
metric_definitions.band_excess_pred: same metric on the centre-slice k-space multiplied by the off-centre/centre navigator echo ratio (complex, per echo) -> predicted from navigator only
metric_definitions.phase_dev: rms deviation of echo 2..N phases from their circular mean (representation-free)
metric_definitions.mm_reference: MM has no centre slice: ROI/baseline from QQQ centre
